message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a costume. Adult costumes of textile material are classified in 6211.43 (women's other garments, of man-made fibers) if they are not festive articles. Under Chapter 95 Note 1(e), the exclusion covers fancy dress of textiles in Chapters 61 and 62, so a costume made of textile is classified in Chapters 61/62. Wings and a headpiece are accessories, but the dress sets the classification. As a set, it would be classified by the essential character of the dress.

Dress, likely polyester, woven: 6211.43.0091 is the "Other garments, women's or girls': of man-made fibers: Other: Other: Women's" line. Under 6211.43, the codes are 6211.43.0010 (Hospital apparel?), 6211.43.1000 (with 2 or more colors in warp or weft - actually 6211.43.10 covers "Other: Other: Women's"?). The subheadings I recall are 6211.43.0091 (Other, Women's, "Other"), and 6211.43.1060 and similar. The typical costume ruling cites 6211.43.1060, "Other garments: Women's or girls': Of man-made fibers: Other: Other: Other." The classification is uncertain, but I'll go with 6211.43.1060.

If the dress were knit, it would be 6104.43.2020 (women's dresses, synthetic, knit). A golden goddess costume is likely a woven dress, probably polyester, so I'll stay with 6211.43.1060.
